overviewParagraph.overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Maxxus Bellevue 3-Person Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a spacious and rejuvenating wellness retreat right in your home. Designed for indoor use, this sauna is perfect for basements, master baths, or fitness rooms, providing a sanctuary for muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. With 7 strategically placed Low EMF FAR infrared carbon heating panels and crafted from natural Canadian Hemlock wood, it ensures a safe and efficient heat experience. Enhance your relaxation with the interior chromotherapy lighting and built-in Bluetooth speakers, creating a personalized spa-like atmosphere.
